# Meko

> Meko is an open-source, agent-native data layer that gives AI agents persistent memory, knowledge bases, and direct database access — all unified on a distributed PostgreSQL backend (YugabyteDB).  Meko enables multi-agent systems, as wells as multi-person teams, to collaborate.

Meko exposes everything through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), making it compatible with any MCP-enabled IDE or framework. Agents connect to a **datapack** — an isolated unit that bundles a database, MCP server, and credentials — to store memories and store knowledge (i.e. store document chunks), index documents for RAG, run SQL queries, and capture observability traces across sessions.  

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](/quick-start/): Sign up for Meko, connect your IDE, create your first memory and knowledge base, and explore the Meko portal

## Core Concepts

- [Datapacks](/architecture/core-concepts/datapacks/): Isolation units that bundle a YugabyteDB database, MCP server, and credentials into a single deployable unit
- [Memory](/architecture/core-concepts/memory/): Persistent agent memory using semantic search (pgvector) and graph relationships (Apache AGE via mem0)
- [Knowledge Bases](/architecture/core-concepts/knowledgebase/): RAG pipelines for chunking, embedding, and indexing documents using pg_dist_rag
- [Graph RAG](/architecture/core-concepts/graph-rag/): Entity-relationship queries over documents using Apache AGE
- [OLTP Data](/architecture/core-concepts/oltp-data/): Direct PostgreSQL-compatible access to structured data via YugabyteDB YSQL
- [Traces](/architecture/core-concepts/traces/): Full observability of agent operations, conversation history, and chain-of-thought reasoning
- [Connectors](/architecture/core-concepts/connectors/): Data source connectors for ingesting content into knowledge bases

## Architecture

- [How Meko Fits](/architecture/how-meko-fits/): Architecture overview, deployment models, and where Meko sits in an agentic stack

## Guides

- [Working with Memory](/guides/working-with-memory/): Add, search, update, manage, and compress agent memories

- [Observability](/guides/observability/): View traces, conversation history, and performance metrics
